_comment: Rwandan proverbs (imigani) and riddles (ibisakuzo) for the popup card widget. rw = original Kinyarwanda, en = English translation, fr = French translation, meaning = interpretive gloss, source = reference numbers from original collection.

proverbs.en: Laws are heavier than stones.
proverbs.fr: Les lois sont plus lourdes que les pierres.
proverbs.meaning: Laws require impossible architects.

proverbs.en: There isn't a place where peace reigns at night.
proverbs.fr: Il n'y a pas d'endroit où la paix règne la nuit.
proverbs.meaning: Peace exists nowhere.

proverbs.en: A proverb never comes as if from nowhere.
proverbs.fr: Un proverbe ne vient jamais de nulle part.
proverbs.meaning: All proverbs have a good reason for existing.

proverbs.en: (Homes) might burn all night, they always go off in the morning.
proverbs.fr: (Les maisons) peuvent brûler toute la nuit, elles s'éteignent toujours au matin.
proverbs.meaning: All conflicts eventually die down.

proverbs.en: The one that grabs a larger portion pretends to be the eldest.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui prend la plus grande part prétend être l'aîné.
proverbs.meaning: There is no stopping the exploitation of the other.

proverbs.en: The other's belly cries and no one hears it.
proverbs.fr: Le ventre de l'autre pleure et personne ne l'entend.
proverbs.meaning: The other's suffering is incomprehensible.

proverbs.en: A name isn't a man.
proverbs.fr: Un nom n'est pas un homme.
proverbs.meaning: A name says nothing of a person.

proverbs.en: There is no pregnancy that isn't useful.
proverbs.fr: Il n'y a pas de grossesse qui ne soit utile.
proverbs.meaning: Said after a fruitless pregnancy.

proverbs.en: The pain of giving birth is never mediocre.
proverbs.fr: La douleur de l'accouchement n'est jamais banale.
proverbs.meaning: Children are always useful, even born-dead.

proverbs.en: Someone's mother always comes first.
proverbs.fr: La mère de quelqu'un passe toujours en premier.
proverbs.meaning: A beloved should always be respected.

proverbs.en: The other's stitch in the side doesn't prevent you from sleeping.
proverbs.fr: Le point de côté de l'autre ne t'empêche pas de dormir.
proverbs.meaning: One never notices the other's misfortunes.

proverbs.rw: Urusha nyina w'umwana imbabazi aba ashaka kumulya
proverbs.en: The one who professes more compassion than a mother tries to eat the child.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui professe plus de compassion qu'une mère cherche à dévorer l'enfant.
proverbs.meaning: No one can be more generous than a mother.

proverbs.en: What reaches the top of the hill cannot be called back.
proverbs.fr: Ce qui atteint le sommet de la colline ne peut plus être rappelé.
proverbs.meaning: What is said can sometimes have terrible consequences.

proverbs.en: The fertilizer of friendship is made of words.
proverbs.fr: L'engrais de l'amitié est fait de paroles.
proverbs.meaning: Peace can only take place through the power of words.

proverbs.en: Speech travels enough.
proverbs.fr: La parole voyage suffisamment.
proverbs.meaning: Anti-phrase used to caution against speaking too much.

proverbs.en: Nothing else but speech.
proverbs.fr: Rien d'autre que la parole.
proverbs.meaning: To have nothing else to offer but speech.

proverbs.en: The sharpness of the tongue defeats the sharpness of the warriors.
proverbs.fr: La tranchant de la langue surpasse le tranchant des guerriers.
proverbs.meaning: Language is better than weapons.

proverbs.en: To raise the eyes isn't to greet the other.
proverbs.fr: Lever les yeux n'est pas saluer l'autre.
proverbs.meaning: The eyes show no real effort to welcome the other; refers to hypocrisy.

proverbs.en: The eye is for looking.
proverbs.fr: L'œil est fait pour voir.
proverbs.meaning: Emphasizes the function of the eye.

proverbs.rw: Mayenya imenya isuku ishyize imbere aliko ntimenya umwanda isize inyuma
proverbs.en: The slug is aware of the cleanliness ahead, never the dirt left behind.
proverbs.fr: La limace voit la propreté devant elle, jamais la saleté laissée derrière.
proverbs.meaning: One cannot preach what one doesn't practice.

proverbs.en: You never know who will make the spade that will avenge you.
proverbs.fr: On ne sait jamais qui forgera la bêche qui te vengera.
proverbs.meaning: The future is always uncertain.

proverbs.en: Ends and beginnings are identical.
proverbs.fr: Les fins et les débuts sont identiques.
proverbs.meaning: There is no true origin.

proverbs.en: Tomorrow's things are told by those coming tomorrow.
proverbs.fr: Les choses de demain sont racontées par ceux qui viennent demain.
proverbs.meaning: The future belongs to no one.

proverbs.rw: Imana iraguha ntimugura iyo muguze iraguhenda
proverbs.en: Imana gives without a deal; if you deal, it will cost you.
proverbs.fr: Imana donne sans marchandage; si tu marchandes, cela te coûtera.
proverbs.meaning: The future is ungrateful.

proverbs.en: No prophet amongst ourselves.
proverbs.fr: Pas de prophète parmi les nôtres.
proverbs.meaning: No one can guess the future.

proverbs.rw: Nta wutinya ijoro atinya icyo balihuliye mo
proverbs.en: No one fears the night; one fears what steps out of it.
proverbs.fr: Personne ne craint la nuit; on craint ce qui en sort.
proverbs.meaning: The unknown isn't frightening — what lurks inside it is.

proverbs.en: One never holds death.
proverbs.fr: On ne retient jamais la mort.
proverbs.meaning: Death always comes unexpectedly.

proverbs.en: Death holds itself in readiness for the ones who laugh.
proverbs.fr: La mort se tient prête pour ceux qui rient.
proverbs.meaning: Death should not be laughed at.

proverbs.en: To escape thunder is to speak about it.
proverbs.fr: Échapper au tonnerre, c'est en parler.
proverbs.meaning: Danger can only be talked about once it is over.

proverbs.en: No one can discard an elder's saying.
proverbs.fr: Personne ne peut rejeter la parole d'un aîné.
proverbs.meaning: Elders tell the future.

proverbs.en: Wrestlers that love one another show each other where the holes are.
proverbs.fr: Les lutteurs qui s'aiment se montrent mutuellement où sont les failles.
proverbs.meaning: Love and hatred never co-exist.

proverbs.en: Where there is peace, daggers are used for shaving.
proverbs.fr: Là où règne la paix, les poignards servent à se raser.
proverbs.meaning: There is no such thing as absolute peace.

proverbs.en: The destiny of two fingers is to live together.
proverbs.fr: Le destin de deux doigts est de vivre ensemble.
proverbs.meaning: Co-habitation cannot be evaded.

proverbs.en: A sibling's relation is one that consumes itself.
proverbs.fr: La relation fraternelle est celle qui se consume.
proverbs.meaning: Fraternity has nothing to do with blood; it has to do with dialogue.

proverbs.en: A distant brother is less valuable than a neighbor.
proverbs.fr: Un frère lointain vaut moins qu'un voisin proche.
proverbs.meaning: The other who is close is more important than a distant sibling.

proverbs.rw: Urugo rutuboye irembo ikije nyira rwo arakira
proverbs.en: From within a courtyard, the owner welcomes all that comes.
proverbs.fr: Depuis la cour, le propriétaire accueille tout ce qui vient.
proverbs.meaning: Hospitality has to be absolute — it cannot be relative.

proverbs.en: The one who finds bedding aspires for a bed-mate.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui trouve une literie aspire à un compagnon de lit.
proverbs.meaning: Once a need is satisfied, another arises.

proverbs.en: "Wait for me" always takes place twice.
proverbs.fr: "Attends-moi" se produit toujours deux fois.
proverbs.meaning: One is never alone.

proverbs.en: The depth of a speech comes with jaws.
proverbs.fr: La profondeur d'un discours vient avec les mâchoires.
proverbs.meaning: There is no escaping the body.

proverbs.en: One lives through the day, one never steps beyond the day.
proverbs.fr: On traverse les jours, on ne dépasse jamais le jour présent.
proverbs.meaning: There is only the present.

proverbs.en: The grateful is rare.
proverbs.fr: Le reconnaissant est rare.
proverbs.meaning: One is often let down by the other.

proverbs.en: The stomach never lets go.
proverbs.fr: L'estomac ne lâche jamais prise.
proverbs.meaning: Survival implies struggle.

proverbs.en: Savoring the world only takes place when you get along.
proverbs.fr: Savourer le monde ne se fait que lorsqu'on s'entend bien.
proverbs.meaning: The world makes no sense without friendship.

proverbs.en: You refuse to run and there goes your fall.
proverbs.fr: Tu refuses de courir et voilà ta chute.
proverbs.meaning: Nothing is gained without risk.

proverbs.en: Dies who is born.
proverbs.fr: Meurt celui qui est né.
proverbs.meaning: Death is already the fate of the one who is born.

proverbs.en: The straight arrow doesn't always kill.
proverbs.fr: La flèche droite ne tue pas toujours.
proverbs.meaning: Destiny can never be controlled — a crooked arrow can kill too.

proverbs.en: No one can stop one's lineage.
proverbs.fr: Personne ne peut arrêter sa lignée.
proverbs.meaning: Every person seeks to survive through their children.

proverbs.en: Whoever doesn't leave a child, leaves behind a proverb.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui ne laisse pas d'enfant laisse un proverbe.
proverbs.meaning: Lineage isn't the only legacy.

proverbs.en: Whoever dies is first affected in their ability to reproduce.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui va mourir est d'abord atteint dans sa capacité à se reproduire.
proverbs.meaning: Death is nothing so long as one survives through one's children.

proverbs.en: Beetles chew from either side, but always end up together inside.
proverbs.fr: Les scarabées mâchent des deux côtés, mais finissent toujours ensemble à l'intérieur.
proverbs.meaning: There is no point acting alone when the aim is shared by all.

proverbs.en: Help from far away arrives after the rain has passed.
proverbs.fr: L'aide venue de loin arrive apres la pluie.
proverbs.meaning: Local help is often more useful than distant promises.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubufasha bwa hafi bugira umumaro kurusha amasezerano ya kure.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'aide proche vaut mieux que les promesses lointaines.

proverbs.en: Unequal hands still greet each other.
proverbs.fr: Des mains inegales se saluent quand meme.
proverbs.meaning: People of different status still need one another.
proverbs.meaningRw: Abantu badahuje ubushobozi cyangwa icyubahiro baracyakenerana.
proverbs.meaningFr: Des personnes de rang different ont toujours besoin les unes des autres.

proverbs.en: A tree is straightened while it is still young.
proverbs.fr: L'arbre se redresse quand il est encore jeune.
proverbs.meaning: Good character is taught early.
proverbs.meaningRw: Uburere bwiza butangirwa umuntu akiri muto.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le bon caractere se forme tot.

proverbs.en: One pillar cannot hold up a house.
proverbs.fr: Un seul pilier ne soutient pas une maison.
proverbs.meaning: Shared work is stronger than solitary effort.
proverbs.meaningRw: Igikorwa kirakomera iyo abantu bagishyize hamwe.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le travail partage est plus solide que l'effort solitaire.

proverbs.en: Those who unite are not defeated by anything.
proverbs.fr: Ceux qui s'unissent ne sont vaincus par rien.
proverbs.meaning: Unity makes difficult work possible.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubumwe butuma ibikomeye bishoboka.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'unite rend possible ce qui est difficile.

proverbs.en: Upbringing is greater than birth.
proverbs.fr: L'education vaut mieux que la naissance.
proverbs.meaning: Character matters more than family origin.
proverbs.meaningRw: Imyitwarire iruta inkomoko umuntu yavukiyemo.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le caractere compte plus que l'origine familiale.

proverbs.en: A good word is a companion of God.
proverbs.fr: Une bonne parole accompagne Dieu.
proverbs.meaning: Kind speech brings peace and dignity.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ijambo ryiza rizana amahoro n'icyubahiro.
proverbs.meaningFr: Une parole bienveillante apporte paix et dignite.

proverbs.en: The night is understood by the one who spent it awake.
proverbs.fr: La nuit est comprise par celui qui l'a veillee.
proverbs.meaning: Only the person who lived a hardship fully knows it.
proverbs.meaningRw: Uwahuye n'ikibazo ni we umenya uburemere bwacyo.
proverbs.meaningFr: Seule la personne qui a vecu l'epreuve la connait vraiment.

proverbs.rw: Utaganiriye na se ntamenya icyo sekuru yasize avuze
proverbs.en: Whoever does not speak with his father cannot know what his grandfather said.
proverbs.fr: Qui ne parle pas a son pere ignore ce que son grand-pere a dit.
proverbs.meaning: Heritage is preserved through conversation between generations.
proverbs.meaningRw: Umurage ubikwa mu biganiro hagati y'abakuru n'abato.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le patrimoine se conserve par le dialogue entre generations.

proverbs.en: One without an elder still has God.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui n'a pas d'aine a toujours Dieu.
proverbs.meaning: When human guidance is absent, hope can still remain.
proverbs.meaningRw: Iyo ubujyanama bw'abantu bubuze, icyizere kiracyabaho.
proverbs.meaningFr: Quand le conseil humain manque, l'espoir demeure.

proverbs.en: The patient person can milk a heifer.
proverbs.fr: La personne patiente peut traire une genisse.
proverbs.meaning: Patience can make difficult tasks succeed.
proverbs.meaningRw: Kwihangana no kwitonda bituma ibikomeye bishoboka.
proverbs.meaningFr: La patience permet de reussir les taches difficiles.

proverbs.en: One who goes to graze begins from home.
proverbs.fr: Celui qui va faire paitre commence a la maison.
proverbs.meaning: Good work begins with responsibilities close to you.
proverbs.meaningRw: Umurimo mwiza utangirira ku nshingano zikwegereye.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le bon travail commence par les responsabilites proches.

proverbs.en: The sorrow of the hen is known by the fence where it scratched.
proverbs.fr: La peine de la poule se voit a la cloture ou elle a gratte.
proverbs.meaning: Pain often leaves signs before it is spoken.
proverbs.meaningRw: Agahinda k'umuntu kagaragarira mu bimenyetso mbere yo kukavuga.
proverbs.meaningFr: La peine laisse souvent des signes avant d'etre dite.

proverbs.en: No maiden criticizes herself.
proverbs.fr: Aucune jeune fille ne se critique elle-meme.
proverbs.meaning: People rarely see their own faults clearly.
proverbs.meaningRw: Umuntu abona amakosa ye bigoranye.
proverbs.meaningFr: On voit rarement ses propres defauts clairement.

proverbs.en: A child is harmed in the way they are carried.
proverbs.fr: Un enfant souffre selon la facon dont on le porte.
proverbs.meaning: Careless care can injure the vulnerable.
proverbs.meaningRw: Kwita ku muntu nabi bishobora kumugirira nabi kurusha kumufasha.
proverbs.meaningFr: Un soin maladroit peut blesser les plus vulnerables.

proverbs.en: One head does not advise itself.
proverbs.fr: Une seule tete ne se conseille pas elle-meme.
proverbs.meaning: Wisdom grows through consultation.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubwenge bwiyongera iyo abantu bajya inama.
proverbs.meaningFr: La sagesse grandit par la consultation.

proverbs.en: An elder's word is sweet again and again.
proverbs.fr: La parole d'un aine reste douce encore et encore.
proverbs.meaning: Elders' advice keeps its value over time.
proverbs.meaningRw: Inama z'abakuru zigumana agaciro uko igihe gihita.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le conseil des anciens garde sa valeur avec le temps.

proverbs.en: The mouth that eats should not speak carelessly.
proverbs.fr: La bouche qui mange ne parle pas avec legerete.
proverbs.meaning: Gratitude requires discretion and respect.
proverbs.meaningRw: Gushimira bisaba kwitonda no kubaha.
proverbs.meaningFr: La gratitude demande discretion et respect.

proverbs.en: The boneless tongue breaks bones.
proverbs.fr: La langue sans os brise les os.
proverbs.meaning: Words can wound more deeply than force.
proverbs.meaningRw: Amagambo ashobora gukomeretsa kurusha imbaraga.
proverbs.meaningFr: Les mots peuvent blesser plus que la force.

proverbs.en: No one knows where night will find them.
proverbs.fr: Nul ne sait ou la nuit le trouvera.
proverbs.meaning: The future is uncertain, so humility is wise.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ejo hazaza ntihamenyekana, ni byiza kwicisha bugufi.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'avenir est incertain, donc l'humilite est sage.

proverbs.en: The road does not warn the traveler.
proverbs.fr: La route ne previent pas le voyageur.
proverbs.meaning: Experience teaches what advice may not reveal.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubunararibonye bwigisha ibyo inama itabasha kwerekana.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'experience enseigne ce que le conseil ne revele pas toujours.

proverbs.en: A borrowed heart does not fill the chest.
proverbs.fr: Un coeur emprunte ne remplit pas la poitrine.
proverbs.meaning: Borrowed courage cannot replace inner conviction.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubutwari bw'ugutira ntibusimbura ukwemera kuva imbere.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le courage emprunte ne remplace pas la conviction interieure.

proverbs.en: Drums are danced to as they sound.
proverbs.fr: On danse selon le son des tambours.
proverbs.meaning: People respond according to the situation before them.
proverbs.meaningRw: Abantu bitwara bakurikije uko ibihe bimeze.
proverbs.meaningFr: On agit selon la situation presente.

proverbs.en: Where the heart desires, the feet go.
proverbs.fr: La ou le coeur desire, les pieds vont.
proverbs.meaning: Desire often directs action.
proverbs.meaningRw: Icyifuzo cy'umutima gikurura ibikorwa by'umuntu.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le desir oriente souvent l'action.

proverbs.en: Whoever ate salt does not forget water.
proverbs.fr: Qui a mange du sel n'oublie pas l'eau.
proverbs.meaning: A need teaches lasting gratitude.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubukene cyangwa inyota bigisha gushimira ibikenewe.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le besoin enseigne une gratitude durable.

proverbs.en: A sweet thing does not remain forever in the cheek.
proverbs.fr: Une chose douce ne reste pas toujours dans la joue.
proverbs.meaning: Pleasure is temporary, so enjoy it with measure.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ibinezeza ntibiramba; bikwiye kwakirwa mu rugero.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le plaisir est passager; il faut le vivre avec mesure.

proverbs.rw: Agatinze kazaza ni amenyo ya ruguru
proverbs.en: What delays but surely comes is the upper teeth.
proverbs.fr: Ce qui tarde mais vient surement, ce sont les dents du haut.
proverbs.meaning: Some outcomes require patience.
proverbs.meaningRw: Hari ibigerwaho bisaba gutegereza.
proverbs.meaningFr: Certains resultats exigent de la patience.

proverbs.en: Where the rope is strong, it is tightened.
proverbs.fr: La ou la corde est solide, on la serre davantage.
proverbs.meaning: Trust grows where reliability has already been shown.
proverbs.meaningRw: Icyizere cyiyongera aho ubudahemuka bwagaragaye.
proverbs.meaningFr: La confiance grandit la ou la fiabilite est prouvee.

proverbs.en: Whoever had a bad dream waits anxiously for morning.
proverbs.fr: Qui a fait un mauvais reve attend le matin avec inquietude.
proverbs.meaning: Fear makes time feel longer.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ubwoba butuma igihe gisa n'ikitagenda.
proverbs.meaningFr: La peur rend le temps plus long.

proverbs.en: Well-done work reveals its maker.
proverbs.fr: Un travail bien fait revele son auteur.
proverbs.meaning: Quality carries the signature of character.
proverbs.meaningRw: Umurimo unoze ugaragaza imyitwarire ya nyirawo.
proverbs.meaningFr: La qualite porte la signature du caractere.

proverbs.rw: Nyiri ukuboko ni we umenya aho kurambukira
proverbs.en: The owner of the arm knows where to stretch it.
proverbs.fr: Le proprietaire du bras sait ou l'etendre.
proverbs.meaning: Each person knows their own capacity best.
proverbs.meaningRw: Buri muntu ni we umenya ubushobozi bwe kurusha abandi.
proverbs.meaningFr: Chacun connait mieux sa propre capacite.

proverbs.en: A culture without people to speak it fades.
proverbs.fr: Une culture sans voix pour la dire s'eteint.
proverbs.meaning: Heritage survives when people continue to share it.
proverbs.meaningRw: Umuco ukomeza kubaho iyo abantu bawuvuga kandi bawusangira.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le patrimoine survit quand les gens continuent a le partager.

proverbs.en: Unpreserved history is carried away by the wind.
proverbs.fr: L'histoire non conservee est emportee par le vent.
proverbs.meaning: Memory needs care, records, and witnesses.
proverbs.meaningRw: Urwibutso rukenera kurindwa, kwandikwa no guhamywa.
proverbs.meaningFr: La memoire a besoin de soin, d'archives et de temoins.

proverbs.en: Whoever listens well preserves twice.
proverbs.fr: Qui ecoute bien conserve deux fois.
proverbs.meaning: Deep listening protects both words and meaning.
proverbs.meaningRw: Gutega amatwi neza birinda amagambo n'ubusobanuro bwayo.
proverbs.meaningFr: Une ecoute attentive preserve les mots et leur sens.

proverbs.rw: Icyo abakuru babitse ni cyo abato baheraho
proverbs.en: What elders preserve becomes the beginning for the young.
proverbs.fr: Ce que les anciens gardent devient le depart des jeunes.
proverbs.meaning: Each generation builds from inherited memory.
proverbs.meaningRw: Buri gisekuru cyubakira ku murage cyasigiwe.
proverbs.meaningFr: Chaque generation construit a partir de la memoire recue.

proverbs.en: A well-told proverb becomes a school.
proverbs.fr: Un proverbe bien dit devient une ecole.
proverbs.meaning: Short sayings can carry deep teaching.
proverbs.meaningRw: Amagambo make ashobora gutwara inyigisho ndende.
proverbs.meaningFr: De courtes paroles peuvent porter un grand enseignement.

proverbs.rw: Umenya igihugu aciye mu rurimi rwacyo
proverbs.en: One knows a country by passing through its language.
proverbs.fr: On connait un pays en passant par sa langue.
proverbs.meaning: Language opens the inner life of a culture.
proverbs.meaningRw: Ururimi rufungura ubuzima bw'imbere bw'umuco.
proverbs.meaningFr: La langue ouvre la vie interieure d'une culture.

proverbs.rw: Ijwi ry'umukuru ntirisaza mu matwi y'abato
proverbs.en: An elder's voice does not grow old in the ears of the young.
proverbs.fr: La voix d'un ancien ne vieillit pas aux oreilles des jeunes.
proverbs.meaning: Good counsel remains fresh across generations.
proverbs.meaningRw: Inama nziza ikomeza kuba nshya mu bisekuru byose.
proverbs.meaningFr: Un bon conseil reste vivant entre les generations.

proverbs.en: Whoever teaches a child is building tomorrow.
proverbs.fr: Qui enseigne un enfant construit demain.
proverbs.meaning: Education shapes the future community.
proverbs.meaningRw: Uburere bw'umwana bwubaka umuryango w'ejo hazaza.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'education forme la communaute de demain.

proverbs.rw: Akari ku mutima gasesekara ku munwa
proverbs.en: What is in the heart spills onto the mouth.
proverbs.fr: Ce qui est dans le coeur deborde sur la bouche.
proverbs.meaning: Speech often reveals hidden feeling.
proverbs.meaningRw: Imvugo y'umuntu akenshi igaragaza ibiri ku mutima.
proverbs.meaningFr: La parole revele souvent le sentiment cache.

proverbs.en: A good day begins in the morning.
proverbs.fr: Une bonne journee commence le matin.
proverbs.meaning: Early effort shapes later results.
proverbs.meaningRw: Imbaraga za kare zigira uruhare ku musaruro w'umunsi.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'effort du matin influence les resultats du jour.

proverbs.en: No single person becomes a country.
proverbs.fr: Une seule personne ne devient pas un pays.
proverbs.meaning: A nation is made through many lives and duties.
proverbs.meaningRw: Igihugu cyubakwa n'abantu benshi n'inshingano basangiye.
proverbs.meaningFr: Une nation se fait par de nombreuses vies et responsabilites.

proverbs.en: Whoever welcomes well preserves the road.
proverbs.fr: Qui accueille bien preserve le chemin.
proverbs.meaning: Hospitality keeps relationships open.
proverbs.meaningRw: Kwakira neza bituma umubano n'inzira bikomeza gufunguka.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'hospitalite garde les relations ouvertes.

proverbs.en: Unspoken heritage snaps like an old rope.
proverbs.fr: Un patrimoine non raconte casse comme une vieille corde.
proverbs.meaning: Traditions must be retold to remain alive.
proverbs.meaningRw: Imigenzo igomba kuvugwa kenshi kugira ngo ikomeze kubaho.
proverbs.meaningFr: Les traditions doivent etre racontees pour rester vivantes.

proverbs.rw: Akabando k'iminsi gacibwa kare kakabikwa kure
proverbs.en: The walking stick for future days is cut early and kept safely.
proverbs.fr: Le baton des jours a venir se coupe tot et se garde loin.
proverbs.meaning: Prepare early for future need.
proverbs.meaningRw: Tegura kare ibyo uzakenera mu minsi iri imbere.
proverbs.meaningFr: Prepare tot ce dont l'avenir aura besoin.

proverbs.en: The cure for poverty is work.
proverbs.fr: Le remede a la pauvrete, c'est le travail.
proverbs.meaning: Dignified effort is the first answer to lack.
proverbs.meaningRw: Gukora mu cyubahiro ni intambwe ya mbere yo guhangana n'ubukene.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'effort digne est la premiere reponse au manque.

proverbs.rw: Uko ugira abandi ni ko bakugira
proverbs.en: As you treat others, so they treat you.
proverbs.fr: Comme tu traites les autres, ils te traitent aussi.
proverbs.meaning: Respect tends to return to the one who gives it.
proverbs.meaningRw: Kubaha abandi akenshi bigarukira ukubaha.
proverbs.meaningFr: Le respect revient souvent a celui qui le donne.

proverbs.en: Nothing is ever perfectly white.
proverbs.fr: Rien n'est parfaitement blanc.
proverbs.meaning: Every situation has limits and imperfections.
proverbs.meaningRw: Buri kintu kigira aho kigarukira n'inenge zacyo.
proverbs.meaningFr: Chaque situation a ses limites et ses imperfections.

proverbs.en: Who refuses to listen has not refused to see.
proverbs.fr: Qui refuse d'ecouter n'a pas refuse de voir.
proverbs.meaning: Experience will teach those who reject advice.
proverbs.meaningRw: Uwanze inama azigishwa n'ibyo azabona.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'experience instruit celui qui refuse le conseil.

proverbs.en: Who starts low reaches far.
proverbs.fr: Qui commence bas va loin.
proverbs.meaning: Humility and steady beginnings can lead to success.
proverbs.meaningRw: Kwicisha bugufi no gutangira buhoro bishobora kugeza umuntu kure.
proverbs.meaningFr: L'humilite et les debuts patients menent loin.
